authority: derived from the measured CMC local-axis Jacobian; no hand-tuned angle

solve.form: (J^T J + lambda I + mu (J^T ez ez^T J + J^T ey ey^T J)) r = J^T t  ;  r <- r/|r|
solve.lambda_note: ridge = 1e-9 * trace(J^T J), scale-aware, numerically stabilising only
solve.mu_note: weight of the DISTAL(+Z) / DORSAL(+Y) avoidance term; mu = 1 gives that penalty the same weight as the T_OPPOSE alignment term

axial_twist_qualification.criterion: pad proxy normal = -(approved thumb NAIL normal); take the sign of local Y that increases dot(pad_proxy_normal, T_OPPOSE)

CMC_OPPOSITION_UNIT_ROTATION.authority: DIRECTION from the X/Z-restricted regularized least-squares solve (local X/Z dominant, per spec section 10); local-Y coefficient MAGNITUDE from a documented share cap and SIGN from the axial-twist qualification (spec section 11); if the twist sign is UNRESOLVED the local-Y coefficient is forced to 0
CMC_OPPOSITION_UNIT_ROTATION.Y_SHARE_CAP_note: diagnostic construction cap (not an anatomical parameter): the axial-twist component may carry at most 25% of the total rotation magnitude so that local X/Z stays dominant
CMC_OPPOSITION_UNIT_ROTATION.solved_uncapped_y_ratio_note: |r_pen.y| / |r_pen_xz| from the unrestricted solve; it is far above the cap, which is exactly why the spec requires the X/Z-dominant restriction

xz_only_variant.note: reported for transparency; it reaches the same T_OPPOSE alignment as the adopted direction, so the X/Z restriction costs nothing

CMC_OPPOSITION_UNIT_ROTATION.case_construction: case pose quaternion = Quaternion(unit_direction, radians(total_magnitude)); total magnitudes are the diagnostic 10/20/30 deg levels, NOT teaching values
CMC_OPPOSITION_UNIT_ROTATION.order_dependence: NONE - a single exponential-map rotation, not an Euler sequence
